meta.review_notes: Camera and microphone access is not explicitly addressed in the privacy policy, despite the app being a photo and video editor. Please verify if the app requests these permissions.

app.name: Canva: AI Video & Photo Editor
app.description: A design and editing platform for creating graphics, videos, photos, presentations, and documents with AI-powered tools.

verdict.one_liner: Canva is a powerful design app, but it shares lots of your data with advertisers and uses your uploads to train AI.
verdict.summary: Canva collects extensive personal information including your identity, location, device info, and uploaded content. It shares this data with numerous advertising partners and data brokers for personalized ads, tracks you across websites using device identifiers, and uses your uploaded designs to train AI models. While the app offers opt-outs for AI training and marketing, and keeps designs private by default, the default privacy posture involves significant data sharing and tracking.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Canva's extensive ad tracking, cross-site data sharing with multiple partners, and AI training on user uploads make it a poor choice for privacy-conscious users unless you actively use the available privacy controls.

red.title: Your email and location are shared with ad networks for matching
red.plain_english: Canva shares your email address, location, and cookie data with advertising partners like Facebook, Google, and LiveRamp so they can match it with other data about you and show you personalized ads.

red.title: Extensive tracking for personalized ads across websites
red.plain_english: Canva uses cookies, device advertising IDs, and web beacons to track what you do on its app and website. It then uses this information to show you targeted ads on other sites like Facebook and Google.

red.title: Your uploaded designs and images are used to train AI models
red.plain_english: Canva analyzes your uploaded content, including designs and images, to train its algorithms and AI products. You can opt out of this in your privacy settings, but it is turned on by default.

red.title: Your device advertising ID is collected and used for targeted ads
red.plain_english: Canva collects your device's advertising identifier (like the iOS Advertising Identifier) to track how you use the app and deliver personalized advertisements.

red.title: Your data could be sold or transferred if Canva is acquired
red.plain_english: Canva says that if the company is sold, merged, or reorganized, your personal information and uploaded content may be shared or transferred as part of that deal.

green.title: You can opt out of AI training, ad tracking, and marketing emails
green.plain_english: Canva gives you privacy settings where you can opt out of having your data used for AI training, third-party data enrichment, and marketing messages.

green.title: Canva Education is ad-free and COPPA/FERPA compliant for students
green.plain_english: Canva's separate Education product does not show ads to students and has been certified as compliant with child privacy laws like COPPA and FERPA in the United States.

green.title: You can request to access, correct, or delete your data
green.plain_english: Canva allows you to contact them to request access to your data, corrections, or deletion. Users in certain regions also have additional rights like data export and objection.

green.title: Your designs are private by default with granular sharing controls
green.plain_english: Designs you create in Canva are set to private by default. You can choose who can see or edit them, and there are multiple sharing options from invite-only to link-based access.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Canva's privacy policy does not explicitly say whether the app accesses your camera or microphone. It does mention that you can upload photos, images, and videos to the Service.
categories.detail: The policy discusses uploaded content extensively but does not specifically describe camera or microphone permissions, live capture, or background access.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Canva collects your location from your IP address, from you directly, and from partners or payment providers. It uses this data to personalize content, improve advertising efficiency, and estimate taxes.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that Canva may collect precise or approximate location by inferring it from your IP address, from user-provided location, and from partners. Location data is used for advertising, analytics, and tax estimation.
categories.policy_excerpt: Canva collects information in order to understand where its users are located... Canva may collect your precise or approximate location: from you, when you provide, correct or confirm your location... by inferring your location from your IP address; and from our partners or your payment provider.
concerns: Location inferred from IP address for advertising
Shared with advertising partners

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Canva does not mention accessing your contacts or phonebook in its privacy policy.
categories.detail: There is no mention of contact list access, contact import, or phonebook collection in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Canva collects the content you upload to your account, such as designs, images, documents, and videos. This is necessary for the app to work.
categories.detail: User-uploaded content is collected and stored. This includes designs, images, documents, videos, and metadata. This is core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: We receive content that you create within Canva and media you upload, such as designs, images, documents, videos, and metadata about your content.
concerns: Uploads are required for core functionality

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Canva shares your information with many third-party companies, including advertising partners like Facebook, Google, and LiveRamp. They use your data to show you personalized ads and may match your email with other data sources.
categories.detail: Canva shares data with affiliates, service providers, and advertising partners. It explicitly names Facebook, Google, LiveRamp, Outbrain, Taboola, and Appsflyer. Email addresses, location, and cookie data may be shared for ad matching. Data may also be transferred in mergers or acquisitions.
categories.policy_excerpt: We partner with third party ad servers, ad networks and social media platforms (like Facebook, Google, LiveRamp, Outbrain, Taboola and Appsflyer) to deliver personalized advertisements... Canva may share certain information with our third party advertising partners, such as your email address, location, cookie information and information relating to your use of our Service.
concerns: Data shared with multiple ad networks and data brokers
Email matching for cross-site advertising
Data may be sold or transferred in mergers or acquisitions

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Canva collects your name, email, birthdate, phone number, and profession when you sign up. It also buys extra info about you from other companies, like your job title and employer, to personalize ads and offers.
categories.detail: Account creation requires extensive personal data. Canva also obtains third-party data (company, job title, seniority, industry) from public sources and data providers. This is combined with usage data for personalized advertising and offers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may ask for certain information when you register for a Canva account or interact with us (such as a username, your first and last names, birthdate, phone number, profession, physical and e-mail address)... We may obtain information about you from third-party sources, such as public sources, social media platforms... and third-party data providers... your company, company size, job title and seniority, industry and other profile information.
concerns: Extensive identity data collected
Third-party data enrichment for advertising
Linked to advertising profile

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Canva tracks what you do in the app and on the web using cookies, device IDs, and web beacons. It uses this data to show you personalized ads on Canva and other websites like Facebook and Google.
categories.detail: Extensive tracking includes cookies, log files, clear GIFs, device identifiers (iOS Advertising Identifier, Android Advertising ID), and location data. Data is used for personalized advertising on third-party sites and platforms. Partners include Facebook, Google, LiveRamp, Outbrain, Taboola, and Appsflyer.
categories.policy_excerpt: We (and our third-party partners) will create online identifiers and collect information using cookies and similar technologies... Device Identifiers used by Canva include the Android Advertising ID and iOS Advertising Identifier... to deliver personalized advertisements that may be of interest to you and measure their effectiveness.
concerns: Cross-site behavioral advertising
Device advertising identifiers collected
Cookies and web beacons for ad tracking
Data shared with multiple ad networks

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Canva says its main app is not for children under 13, but it does offer a separate Canva Education service for students that is COPPA and FERPA compliant.
categories.detail: Main Service is not directed at children and children are not permitted to sign up. Canva Education is a separate supervised service for K-12 students with parental consent and strict safeguards. COPPA and FERPA certified.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Service and our content are not directed at children. Children are not permitted to sign up by themselves for the Service... Canva Education has been certified compliant with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) by iKeepSafe.
concerns: Main app lacks explicit age verification mechanism

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Canva logs your IP address, the pages you visit, and the links you click. It uses this information to figure out your location and show you targeted ads.
categories.detail: Log files include web request, browser type, referring/exit pages, URLs, clicks, pages viewed. IP addresses are used for location inference. Cookies track pages viewed and links clicked for advertising and analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: Log file information is automatically reported by your browser or mobile device each time you access the Service... These server logs may include anonymous information such as your web request, browser type, referring / exit pages and URLs, number of clicks and how you interact with links on the Service, domain names, landing pages, pages viewed...
concerns: IP address used for location inference
Browsing activity logged for advertising
Clickstream data collected

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Canva collects device identifiers from your phone, including your iOS Advertising Identifier, to track how you use the app and show you ads.
categories.detail: Device identifiers including UUID, Android Advertising ID, and iOS Advertising Identifier are collected. These may remain persistently on the device and are used for login, navigation, and tracking usage for advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may access, collect and/or monitor one or more 'device identifiers,' such as a universally unique identifier ('UUID')... Device Identifiers used by Canva include the Android Advertising ID and iOS Advertising Identifier.
concerns: Advertising identifiers collected
Persistent device tracking
Used for ad targeting

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Canva does not collect health or biometric data according to its privacy policy.
categories.detail: There is no mention of health data, biometric data, or Face ID usage in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Canva collects payment information to bill you for transactions. The policy does not explicitly state whether Canva stores your full card details or uses a third-party processor.
categories.detail: Billing information is collected for transactions. The policy mentions billing and obtaining location from payment providers, but does not specify whether raw card data is stored by Canva or handled entirely by a third-party processor.
categories.policy_excerpt: giving you access to your designs and billing you for transactions that you make via the Service
concerns: Policy unclear on whether card details are stored

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can ask Canva to delete your data, but they may keep some of it for legal reasons, backups, and audits even after you close your account.
categories.detail: Users can request access, correction, or deletion via privacy@canva.com. However, after account termination, profile information and User Content are retained for a 'commercially reasonable time' and for legal, audit, backup, and archival purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Following termination or deactivation of your user account, Canva will retain your profile information and User Content for a commercially reasonable time, and for as long as we have a valid purpose to do so. In particular, Canva will retain your information for the purpose of complying with its legal and audit obligations, and for backup and archival purposes.
concerns: Data retained after account deletion for legal and backup purposes

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Canva will update the date on its privacy policy when it changes. For big changes, it says it will email you or post a notice on its website.
categories.detail: Material changes are notified via website or email. The 'Last Updated' date is revised. However, continued use is implied as acceptance. No requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: When we post changes to this policy, we will revise the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this policy. If we make any material changes to the way we collect, use, store and/or share your personal information, we will notify you on our website or by sending an email to the email address associated with your Canva account.
concerns: Continued use implies acceptance of changes
